notes: Multi-Currency Basket Correlation Dispersion Hedger. EA runs one instance per registered host symbol; each instance reads the 7-pair USD basket on H1 to compute USD basket rate-of-change and cross-sectional dispersion, trading the host symbol when it reaches extreme dispersion. Foreign reads are bound at call site via QM_SymbolGuardInit + QM_BasketWarmupHistory; one position per magic on the host symbol. All 7 pairs verified present in dwx_symbol_matrix.csv.
